title.narrative: Supporting Uganda’s Response to HIV/AIDS and Tuberculosis Reduction Strategy - Uganda (01-Jan-2021-31-Dec-2023)

description.narrative: Uganda, TB/HIV, The AIDS Support Organisation (Uganda) Limited (TASO)This program has the following goals: Increase productivity, inclusiveness and wellbeing of population through ending HIV and AIDS as an epidemic by 2030. To reduce the incidence of TB from 200/100,000 to 160/100,000 by 2024/25. The objectives of this program are: To reduce the number of youth and adult HIV infections by 65% and paediatric HIV infections by 95% by 2025. To reduce HIV related morbidity and mortality and contribute to preventing new HIV infections by 2025. To strengthen social and economic protection to reduce vulnerability to HIV and AIDS and mitigation of its impact on PLHIV, OVC, key populations and other vulnerable groups. To strengthen the multi-sectoral HIV and AIDS service delivery system that ensures sustainable access of efficient and quality services to all targeted populations. To strengthen the national HIV and AIDS strategic information management system for improved effectiveness and efficiency. To create awareness about TB and increase the proportion of people with TB symptoms that seek appropriate care from health facilities from 61% to 90% by 2024/2025. To increase TB preventive treatment coverage among eligible people to >90% by 2024/25. To increase TB treatment coverage from 76% in 2019 to >90% by 2024/25. To increase TSR from 72% in 2019 to >90% by 2024/25. To build effective and efficient systems that ensure quality, equitable and timely TB and Leprosy services
